definitions.explanation: The way a character or word is read or pronounced.
The ability to read or understand; one's interpretation of a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わからない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know how to read this kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
examples.english: He has a deep understanding of the situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えよう→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's learn the on'yomi and kun'yomi readings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧。
examples.english: That coach has a keen reading of the game.
My reading of what was ahead was too optimistic.

notes:
{読|よ}み is the noun form of ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read). It can refer to pronunciation or to one's interpretation/analysis of a situation.

KANJI READING TYPES:
- ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧: Chinese-derived reading (on'yomi)
- ⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧: Japanese-native reading (kun'yomi)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧: shallow reading/analysis
- {読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: deep reading/insight
- {読|よ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: naive interpretation
- {読|よ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誤|あやま}る→誤る：27433_ayamaru⟧: to misread (a situation)

In games like shogi or go, {読|よ}み refers to reading ahead—predicting future moves.
